title: What to know about the UN climate talks
excerpt: Delegates, lobbyists, and journalists have gathered in Antalya, Turkey, for the annual UN climate talks.
body_html:
Thousands of delegates, lobbyists, and journalists have gathered for the annual United Nations climate talks. This year's event is taking place in Antalya, Turkey.

The negotiations officially kicked off on November 8, marking the start of discussions on a major stage within the global climate community. Turkey and Australia are cohosting the event.
